t: Multi-use cloth wipes effectively clean up oil, grease, ink, paint, silicones and uncured PU foam. Provides 3-in-1 action to lift, clean and protect. Strong and soft cloth-like texture is resistant to rips and deterioration during use. Wipes remain wet and usable for over an hour and don’t dry out when the lid is left open. Flexible packaging allows for one wipe to be dispensed at a time.
b: For Medium to Heavy Duty Work
